insight.headline: VEL-11 breaks KEP's block with a 27.4 m pass in the 82nd minute at 2-2
insight.why_it_matters: With the score level at 2-2 in the 82nd minute, VEL needed a route past a set KEP defensive structure rather than sideways circulation. VEL-11's completed pass from a central midfield position (x 54.9, y 43.6) into x 80.9 removed a line of KEP players at the moment of highest pressure in the sequence (0.88), converting a contested possession into an attacking-third entry. The value of the action is that it was executed under pressure and at high difficulty (7.2) rather than from a free zone, and it was immediately followed by a carry to x 92.8, meaning the line break changed where the ball was played, not just who had it.
insight.watch_next: Watch item, not an observed pattern: KEP re-established possession immediately afterwards through KEP-03 and KEP-05 (e-001094, e-001096), so the relevant question is whether VEL's advanced positions from this line break leave them exposed to a quick counter.

claims.text: VEL-11 completed the line-breaking pass to VEL-09 while under 0.88 event pressure, so the progression was made out of a congested area rather than a free one.
The pass added 0.242 in expected threat, moving VEL from a midfield position into the attacking third of the pitch.
The ball travelled 27.4 m from x 54.9 to x 80.9 at a rated difficulty of 7.2 and a ball speed of 23.0 km/h, indicating a long, driven pass through KEP's structure rather than a short link pass.

The break came in the same phase as VEL-06's tackle won at 0.77 pressure (e-001090), after VEL-04 lost a tackle at 0.60 pressure (e-001089), so the progression started from a direct defensive recovery rather than settled possession.
VEL-03 then carried 12.9 m to x 92.8 under only 0.25 pressure (e-001092), showing the space created by the line break was not immediately closed by KEP.

fan_cards.headline: VEL-11 threads a 27.4 m pass through KEP's block at 2-2
fan_cards.what_happened: It was tied 2-2 in the 82nd minute. VEL-11 picked up the ball in a crowded midfield spot and fired a long, driven pass 27.4 metres forward, right through a wall of KEP players. VEL-03 then carried it further up the pitch with barely any pressure on him.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: Instead of passing sideways, VEL found a way straight through KEP's set defence at the tensest moment of the game. The pass opened up room at the other end of the pitch, turning a scrap in midfield into a real attack.
fan_cards.watch_next: KEP won the ball straight back, so watch whether VEL get caught out on the counter after pushing so far forward.
fan_cards.how_we_know: The evidence is VEL-11's completed 27.4 m pass under 0.88 pressure (e-001091), followed by VEL-03's 12.9 m carry (e-001092) and KEP's immediate recoveries (e-001094, e-001096).

Instead of recycling sideways you drive a 27.4 m pass at 23.0 km/h through the line to x 80.9 — a 7.2 difficulty ball struck while 0.88 pressure is on you. fan_cards.headline: VEL-11 rompe el bloque de KEP con un pase de 27,4 m en el minuto 82
fan_cards.what_happened: VEL-11 recibió en el centro (x 54,9) con 0,88 de presión encima, aguantó y filtró un pase largo de 27,4 m hasta x 80,9 con velocidad de balón de 23,0 km/h y dificultad 7,2. No fue un pase cómodo: salió de zona congestionada y superó una línea entera de KEP. El balón siguió avanzando después, con VEL-03 conduciendo 12,9 m hasta x 92,8 con solo 0,25 de presión.
fan_cards.why_it_matters: Para ti, centrocampista: ese es el movimiento que cambia el partido. Recibir bajo presión, girar y romper la línea con un pase tenso en vez de circular lateralmente. Además llegó tras una recuperación directa (entrada de VEL-06 al 0,77 de presión), no desde posesión asentada, así que el pase convirtió una disputa en entrada al tercio ofensivo.
fan_cards.watch_next: Ojo a la espalda de VEL-11: KEP recuperó el balón enseguida con KEP-03 y KEP-05, así que vigila si sus posiciones adelantadas tras la ruptura dejan al equipo expuesto al contragolpe.
fan_cards.how_we_know: Se apoya en el evento e-001091 (pase completado con presión 0,88, xt +0,242 y dificultad 7,2) y en los eventos e-001089, e-001090 y e-001092 de la misma secuencia.
